GUIDELINES

CSA, CAD, CIS-Data Foundation: COMPLETION TIMING POINTS

All certifications under this category (CSA, CAD, CIS-DF) will follow the scoring system below and has a deadline of JUNE 30

DAYS BEFORE THE DEADLINE Points
90 Days 100 pts
60 Days 75 pts
30 Days 50 pts
14 Days 25 pts

 

AI ADVANTAGE: DOUBLE THE POINTS (COMPLETED)

In support of the ServiceNow AI learning initiative and CPL, AI-certifications had double the points compared to non-AI certifications, for completions done between MARCH 1 and MAY 18.

Since the Double the Points event is now over, we will go back to its original pointing system.

  AI Certifications Other Certifications (Non-AI)
Micro-certifications 100 pts each > 50 pts each 50 pts each
Mainline/Accreditations 200 pts each > 100 pts each 100 pts each

 

For more information regarding the Certathon, please check our sharepoint PH KDN ServiceNow - Documents > Enabling Functions > Delivery & Governance > Internal Intiatives
